passive.name: Stone Skin
passive.description: Wukong gains stacking armor and max health regeneration while fighting champions and monsters.

spells.name: Crushing Blow
spells.description: Wukong and his Clone's next Attack gains range, deals an additional physical damage, and removes % Armor for seconds. This Ability's cooldown is reduced by seconds every time Wukong or his Clone hit an enemy with an Attack or Ability. This Ability triggers spell effects upon dealing damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation BonusDamageTT was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Warrior Trickster
spells.description: Wukong dashes and becomes Invisible for second, leaving behind a stationary Clone for seconds. The Clone Attacks nearby enemies Wukong has recently damaged and will mimic his ultimate, each dealing % of normal damage.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: Nimbus Strike
spells.description: Wukong dashes to an enemy, sending out Clones that mimic the dash to up to additional enemies nearby. Each enemy struck takes magic damage. He and his Clone gain % Attack Speed for seconds.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Cyclone
spells.description: Wukong gains % Move Speed and spins his staff, Knocking Up nearby enemies for seconds and take plus max Health physical damage over seconds. This Ability can be cast a second time within seconds before going on cooldown.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamageTT was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
